theorems.name: Submission.idtp_imrep_measure_density_ae
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), 1 ≤ n → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → R.measure K ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂μHE[n], Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => R.measure (ball x ρ) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (Set.indicator R.carrier (fun y => (R.mult y : ℝ≥0∞)) x))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
